description.value: AVIK is a tech-driven franchise specialty coffee shop on West Broadway offering espresso drinks crafted with beans from Moving Coffee Roastery, locally sourced high-grade teas, and artisanal pastries baked in-house daily. The brand blends a digital-first experience — including a mobile app with an order-ahead and rewards system — with a self-described fun, vibrant atmosphere. It sits in a busy urban neighbourhood convenient to cyclists travelling the Broadway corridor.
